speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.dawncrest.0: Up before the sun, are you?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.dawncrest.1: Gilt like that, you'll want to be on the wall by the last watch.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.dawncrest.2: My mother bowed to plate like that once.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.golden_executi: I won't ask whose turn it is.
Keep that edge away from my door.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.wind_worshippe: You walk like the ground owes you nothing.
Mind the edge. Or don't, I suppose.
That cloth smells of high air.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.fog_guard.0: Didn't see you there. I suppose that's the point.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.fog_guard.1: Grey as the overcast, you are.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.dark_lord.0: That's not from anywhere near here.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.dark_lord.1: It's warm. Why is it warm?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.dark_lord.2: Don't stand by the hay in that.
Hunting something that walks at night?
Silver on the cuffs. I'll sleep better.
Bit late in the day for a coat like that.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.grave_sentinel: That's barrow iron. You've been down there.
And the dead let you keep that?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.dragonslayer.0: That plate's seen something big fall.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.dragonslayer.1: Heavy, that. Like it was cut from a hill.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.dragonslayer.2: Were you there when it came down?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.dead_gladiator: Pit gear. Got the scars to go with it?
Last harness like that I saw was out on the sand.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.twinned.0: Where's the other half of you?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.ronin.0: Folded plate. You've been out east among the blossoms?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.ronin.1: Pretty, that. Does it stop a blade?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.set.ronin.2: Like a lord's man out of the cherry country.
